body.en:
You have just accepted a mission. In order to complete the mission you will have to perform the objectives requested.
In order to complete an objective you need to view the mission and click the appropriate button for the objective.
If you are starting a courier mission you might be able to complete the first objective now, if the item you need to transport is located at this station.
body.zh:
你刚刚接受了一项任务。若要完成任务，你必须完成所有提出的任务目标。
为了完成目标，你必须查看任务，点击正确的按钮以查看目标。
如果你正着手一项运输任务，而你需要运输的物品就在这个空间站里，那么你现在就有能力完成第一个目标了。

body.en: Planetary Industry (P.I.) is an industry process that takes raw materials from a planet and turns them into goods available on the market at large. Creating extractors, processors and other parts of the industry involves setting up a command center and investing ISK to set it all up. Like most industries, you must have some skills trained to get started. The Remote Sensing skill allows you to survey planets for areas rich in natural resources. Other skills are necessary for running multiple colonies or running colonies remotely. These skills are available on the market.
body.zh: 行星工业是一种工业化程序，它从行星上采集原材料并将其大批量转化为市场上常见的商品。你需要先建立一个指挥中心并且花费ISK维持它的运作，这样才能建造采集器、处理设施以及其他一些东西。与大多数其它工业一样，你必须训练相关的技能才能开始进行行星互动。遥测感应技术技能使你能够勘测行星上面自然资源丰富的区域。其它一些技能还可以让你有能力建造多个殖民地或是远程控制你的殖民地。这些技能都可以在市场中买到。

body.en: The environment of this Abyssal Deadspace is incredibly unstable and hostile. Your probes have minimal environmental shielding and will most certainly be destroyed if you deploy them outside this pocket. Are you sure you want to continue and deploy your probes?
body.zh: 深渊空间中的环境极其不稳定而且危险。你的探针对环境的抗性很弱，如果发射到这个空间层之外就很可能会损毁。你确定要继续发射探针吗？

body.zh: 同意这份合同时，并不会自动指定职位或可转授职位。职位和可转授职位是由军团成员，比如人事主管、总监或CEO，来分配给申请者的。

body.en: Your ship is carrying at least one item (…) which is contraband in this solar system, are you sure you wish to jump?

You are receiving a ship through this trade session. Keep in mind that even though you may have been told otherwise, this ship does not necessarily contain any modules or rigs.

If you want to be safe you should accept the ship through an Item Exchange contract instead.

body.zh:
你将在此交易期收到一艘飞船。尽管你可能已经知道，但还是要提醒你，这艘飞船不一定装备任何设备或改装件。

body.en: You will be warped to the tutorial, do you wish to proceed? Canceling will close the tutorial.
body.zh: 你将会跃迁到教程地点，想去那里吗？按“取消”会关闭教程。

body.zh: 如果你现在跃迁离开，那么教程会中断并自动关闭。

Warning! You are currently flagged for being part of combat actions and you are about to enter an area with people wanting to kill you! If you continue they will use all means necessary to kill you and the station will probably not let you back in.

Are you sure you want to continue?
body.zh:
警告！你目前被确认参与了一场战斗，你将要进入的区域里有人想杀你！如果你执意前行，那他们将对你全力追杀，并且空间站人员也可能不让你停靠。

你确定要继续吗？

body.zh: 你打算注销舰队。确定要这样做吗？

body.zh: 你的军团有一个名为…的装配方案，  你想要更新它吗？

body.zh: 你有一个名为…的装配方案，  你想要更新它吗？

body.en: If you proceed with this action … will be removed from all groups in your …. Do you want to do that?
body.zh: 如果你继续这项操作，…将从你…中的所有组中删除。你确定要这么做吗？

body.en:
You are warping to a stargate owned by … whom you have recently engaged in combat. Customs police are operating on a low tolerance policy and will attack you if they are present.

Do you wish to proceed with this dangerous action?
body.zh:
你正向…的星门跃迁，而你最近刚和他战斗过。海关警察正采取低容忍政策，如果他们在场，就会攻击你。

你想继续此项危险行动吗？

body.en: If you are searching for another capsuleer, a system or a corporation then you can use the search functionality here. You can also see your buddy list and your blocked list, a list of your agents and corporation members, and all the locations in space you might have bookmarked.
body.zh: 如果你要查找其他的飞行员、一个星系、或一个军团等等，你都可以使用这里的搜索功能。你也可以在这里查看你的好友列表和阻止列表，查看你的代理人和军团成员还有太空中所有你添加过位标的地点。

body.en: All your ships and items throughout the universe can be viewed from within the assets window. Here you can see a categorized list of your items, on a station by station basis. You can also search for items you might have temporarily misplaced. Perhaps some treasure awaits you!
body.zh: 你在宇宙中任何地方的舰船和各种物品都可以通过这个窗口找到。在这里你可以看到一个按照空间站划分包含你所有物品的分类列表。你也可以按名称搜索你不小心忘记放在哪里了的物品。或许还能从自己的杂货堆里翻出什么好东西来，呵呵！

body.en: Use the calendar to plan ahead and keep track of important events or tasks which you can share with your friends, corp  and alliance. The calendar is easy to use and can also be accessed through your EVE Gate profile
body.zh: 使用日历有助于你做计划、办活动。你可以利用它来追踪重要活动或任务的进展，将它们与你的朋友、军团及联盟共分享。日历用起来十分简便。你还可以通过EVE Gate来使用日历。

body.en: Certificates are a good way to clearly see how to reach a goal in your character development. By picking a certificate, you can quickly see what skills you need to obtain it. Although certificates do not grant you any special bonuses, it will allow you, through the skills to become a more qualified pilot in that area.
body.zh: 证书可以清晰地显示你的人物在成长中取得的成就情况。选中一个证书就可以查看获取它所需的相关技能。虽然证书系统并不为你提供任何特殊的加成，但是它可以帮助你在各个领域成为更优秀的飞行员。

body.en: To facilitate easy communicaton with others, you can join various chat channels to discuss all aspects of space faring. Whether it's the locations of asteroids or enemy factions, or the latest alliance news, or stock tips, or just plain gossip, there's probably a channel out there for you - and if there's not, you can make your own!
body.zh: 这里的工具让你更快捷和方便地同其他玩家进行交流。你可以加入不同的聊天频道，在星际航行中参与不同事件的讨论。它可以是有关小行星带位置的，讨论敌对势力状况的，最新的联盟新闻，股票消息，或者干脆只是八卦闲聊，你都可以找到适合你的频道。就算没有找到一个感兴趣的聊天频道，你还可以自己创建一个！

body.en: The character sheet is one of the most important tools in EVE. Here you select skills for training, write your biography, and check on your attributes, clones, standings, employment history and more. It is a valuable source of information on your character development and should not be overlooked.
body.zh: 人物表单是EVE中最重要的工具之一。在这里你可以安排你的技能学习，编写你的个人信息，查看你的属性、克隆体、声望及雇佣记录等情况。这里提供与你的人物成长相关的关键数据和信息，请不要忽视它们。

body.en: Some items might generate a better profit when sold through auction. Using the contract system, you can auction off your items, exchange them for other items directly, set up part-exchange deals... the contract system gives you the flexibility to choose the right kind of deal for the situation. Countless deals are closed every day, relying on the contract system's rules to prevent swindles and scams. If you have a rare item, others might be willing to fight for it in an auction!
body.zh: 有些东西要是放在拍卖行里的话或许能卖个好价钱。通过使用合同系统，你可以直接拍卖或者交换你的物品。合同系统让你能够制订各种合同来满足不同的需要。在这里每天都有无数的交易成功完成，这都归功于合同系统精心设计的防欺诈规则。如果你有稀罕的物品，可能会引得他人拼着命来拍哦！

body.en: Here within you can find tools to manage your corporation, or to set one up. You can also find the corporate registry, which enables you to either quickly find a corporation for yourself, or to list your own corporation to others. You can also manage all roles to your members, manage wars and take care of alliance needs.
body.zh: 在这里你可以创建或管理军团。你也能够找到军团的招募信息，通过它你可以迅速找到你心仪的军团，或者把你的军团公布在列表中供别人查阅。你也可以在这里管理军团的职位、头衔和成员，以及打理战争和联盟事务。

body.en: Your ships need to be fitted with weapons, defensive modules, cargo expanders, mining lasers and other equipment to reach their full potential. The fittings window grants you access to the ship's hardware, where you can install your equipment and view statistics like resistances, cargo space and more.
body.zh: 你的舰船需要合理装配各种武器、防护装备、货柜扩展装备、采矿器及其他必要装备来发挥其最大功效。装配界面可让你对舰船硬件直接进行管理，在这里你可以于安装各种装备的同时查看它们的状态数据，如抗性与货舱容量等。

body.en: This window gives you access to options and information about fleets. Here you can form and manage your fleet, or use the Fleet Finder to search for friendly fleets.
body.zh: 在该窗口中，你可以查看舰队相关信息并进行相应操作。你可以在此组队并对其进行管理。你也可以使用“舰队搜寻器”来寻求志同道合的其他舰队。

body.en: To stay in contact with your friends, you can use EVE mails. These are handy and easy to use - your friend will receive it instantly, thanks to the wonders of fluid router technology. You'll also receive communications from all kinds of other entities through this interface, from insurance notices to offers of work.
body.zh: 使用EVE邮件服务，你可以同你的朋友们保持联络。这个工具使用起来十分方便简单，归功于先进的星际通讯中继技术，你的朋友能即时收到你的邮件。你也能够在这里收到保险通知、工作邀请等来自其他用户和机构的通讯。

body.en: If your ship is not insured, you should perhaps consider changing this! Insurance comes in several levels, to minimize your financial loss in case of the destruction of a ship. Be sure to check on your insurance regularly, as standard policies only last for 12 weeks - losing a ship whose insurance expired the previous week is rarely a happy event.
body.zh: 如果你的舰船尚未投保，那你或许应该考虑一下了！保险分几档，能将舰船被毁后产生的经济损失尽量减小。记得要经常检查你的保险界面，标准的保单有效期仅为12个星期——如果你的舰船被毁而它的保险是上个星期才刚刚过期的，那就有的你好后悔了。

body.en: Here within you can find information regarding your agent missions, your ongoing research as well as a list of all corporations that you have gained loyalty points with and how many. On this page you can find information related to the journal, tutorials, knowledgebase articles on how to operate and make best use of the journal.
body.zh: 在这里你可以找到关于你的代理人任务的信息，你目前的科研点数情况，以及你获得忠诚点数的军团列表和相应点数等。你还能查看正在进行的远征及萨沙入侵等信息。好好利用你的日志系统吧。

body.en: While doing missions for agents, you might notice that you receive loyalty points as additional payment for finishing the mission successfully. These points can be spent at the corresponding corporation's stations. Items vary between corporations and races, and scientists and technicians work hard on bringing new types of equipment to the store as soon as it is available.
body.zh: 在完成代理人任务的同时，你或许已经注意到，除了获得金钱和物品奖励外，你还能获得忠诚点数作为额外的奖励。这些点数能在对应的NPC军团空间站里使用。可兑换的物品根据军团和种族有不同的变化，而且科学家和技术人员们不停地努力工作以将最新的物品带到商店里。

body.en: To stay in contact with other players and friends, you can use EVE mails. These are handy and easy to use - your recipient will receive it instantly, thanks to the wonders of fluid router technology. You'll also receive communications from all kinds of other entities through this interface.
body.zh: 使用EVE邮件服务，你可以同你的朋友们保持联络。这个工具使用起来十分方便简单，归功于先进的星际通讯中继技术，你的朋友能即时收到你的邮件。你也能够在这里收到来自于各类机构的通讯。

body.en: For all your scientific and industry related ventures! You can initiate, monitor and finalize all your manufacturing and researching tasks from within the confines of the science & industry window.
body.zh: 所有敢于在科学和工业中冒险的人，这里是你们的天堂。你可以在这里发起、监控及完成各种制造和研究工作。

body.en: The map can show both your current solar system, and the whole universe. It provides you with information and statistics, and acts as a tool for planning your route around your constellation, region or between regions.
body.zh: 星图既可以显示你当前所在的恒星系，也可以显示整个宇宙。星图能向你提供各种信息和统计数据，同时也是你制订星际航行计划的好帮手。

body.en: The market is a tool that nearly everyone accesses at on a daily basis. Whether it's to buy a new ship, acquire the latest in weapons technology or to trade countless other items with your fellow pilots. Here you can find it all, and here you can work the market to gain riches and fortune as a trader.
body.zh: 市场几乎每个人每天都会接触。无论是购买舰船，了解最新武器行情，还是向其他飞行员买卖各种物品，你都可以在这里完成。在这儿，如果你有良好的商业头脑，说不定还能成为腰缠万贯的贸易家。

body.en: It is imperative that you keep an up to date clone. In the event of your death, your body will be rematerialized at your selected station. If your clone doesn't support the skill points you have, you could lose some of them in the process. Always ensure that your clone can store more skill points than you currently have.
body.zh: 保持自己的克隆体随时更新在EVE的世界里面是非常重要的。如果你死亡了，你的身体将在你所选择的空间站内再造。如果你死亡前的克隆等级未能涵盖你的全部技能点数，那么你可能于再造过程中损失一部分技能点数。请随时确保你的克隆等级所保存的技能点数可以涵盖你当前所拥有的总技能点数。

body.en:
This is the information hub for the war effort. In this panel you can enlist yourself or your corporation, and once enlisted access data and statistics about the war effort.Individuals may enlist by leaving any current player corporations, ensuring their standing from this faction is above 0.5 and that they're not on a trial account; applications are processed immediately.
Directors and CEOs may enlist their entire corporation by leaving any current alliance and ensuring their corporate standing from this faction is above 0.5; applications are processed at downtime.All enlisted players are in a state of permanent war with their enemies and may be attacked by enemy capsuleers at any time. They are also advised to avoid high security space (0.5 security and above) belonging to enemy factions, as those factions' navies will shoot on sight.Enlisted players are empowered to take missions from agents in their Militia, and to assist in the capture of strategic locations. Missions are limited by ship type. Locations are exploration sites found using the onboard scanner, are limited by ship type and have proximity sensors on strategic capture sites that trigger a capturing timer.For further information on all aspects of the war, please visit the knowledge base!
body.zh:
这里是势力战争的情报中心。在这里你可以个人身份或带领军团入伍应征，并在加入后看到各种数据情报。个人可以通过退出当前玩家军团的方式加入势力战争，同时还要保证与所投势力的声望值大于0.5且使用的账号是非试玩账号；入伍申请马上就能有结果。

总监及CEO可以通过退出当前所属联盟投入势力战争，当然同样要保证所入势力对自己军团的声望值在0.5以上；加入申请将在一次系统维护后知道结果。所有入伍玩家都与其敌方处于长期交战状态，在任何时候都能遭到对方的合法攻击。我们建议加入了势力战争的玩家尽量不要前往敌方享有主权的高安全等级地区（0.5及以上），因为这些地方的势力海军对敌人是见到就打的。加入势力战争的玩家可以接到来自他们的国民卫队代理人的任务，也可以去协助夺取战略要地。势力战争任务对舰船类型是有一定限制的。战略要地是那些可以用舰载扫描器探测出的异常空间，它们对于可进入的舰船种类同样有所限制，并且设有范围传感器，可以触发抢占计时器进行倒计时。要想全面了解势力战争，请查阅相关知识网页！

body.en: The bounty office holds information on all criminals in the galaxy. You can browse through the most wanted list and see if you spot any friends of yours or perhaps your most sworn enemy. You can also add a bounty to others if you so desire.
body.zh: 荣誉追击办公室向你提供宇宙中各个不法分子的信息。你可以在这里浏览追击排行榜看看你和你的朋友是不是榜上有名，或者说不定还能找到你的死敌。当然你也可以在这里自己设定添加一个追击对象。

body.en: Your ship can sustain damage in space and might need repairs. Stations often feature repairshops that can patch up your ships for a small fee.
body.zh: 你的舰船在太空中遭受的损伤需要修理。空间站通常会提供修理业务，花费一定的费用就可以让你的船只得到完全修复。

body.en: Ore can be reprocessed into minerals using the reprocessing plant. Each type of ore has its own particular makeup and reprocesses into a unique combination of minerals. Skills can affect how well you reprocess, and standings from the owner of the station can also have an effect. You can also reprocess modules, ships and other items into their base mineral components.
body.zh: 矿石通过提炼工厂提炼可以产出矿物材料。每种矿石都有其不同的成分，通过提炼可以产出不同的矿物组合。提炼的效果会受到技能的影响，你在该空间站主人处的声望也是一个重要的因素。同样，你也可以在这里把装备、舰船或其他物品也拿来提炼，使其再次转化为基本的矿物原料。

body.en: This dashboard keeps you informed of the changes to sovereignty throughout New Eden. Changes to individual solar systems, constellations, regions or the whole cluster are visible as well. Information about systems' indices are also displayed.
body.zh: 在此窗口中，你将了解到宇宙中所有星系主权的变更情况。单个星系、星座、星域及全宇宙的变化情况也能通过此窗口获悉。另外你还能在此查阅星系指数相关信息。

body.en: This dashboard keeps you informed of the changes to sovereignty throughout New Eden. Changes to individual solar systems, constellations, regions or the whole cluster are visible as well. Information about systems' indices are also displayed.
body.zh: 在此窗口中，你将了解到宇宙中所有星系主权的变更情况。单个星系、星座、星域及全宇宙的变化情况也能通过此窗口获悉。另外你还能在此查阅星系指数相关信息。

body.en: When the privileged and powerful of New Eden yearn for commodities beyond what is normally available on the public market, they turn to the Noble Exchange, a private bazaar of diverse goods governed by the aurum currency. The spectrum of merchandise stretches from current fashions to those that are exceptionally rare or of dubious legality.These transactions are overseen and guaranteed by CONCORD, but due to the fact that only those with access to aurum and qualified merchant corporations may use the Noble Exchange, virtually all inconsistencies, loopholes, and exploits have been systematically eliminated.
body.zh: 新伊甸中的特权阶级和达官贵人们早已对市面上的普通货色不屑一顾，怀着对上等货品的渴盼，他们来到了新伊甸商城，这是一个陈列着各色商品的私人交易市场，使用AUR作为货币进行交易。这里的商品琳琅满目，从流行时尚到奇珍异宝甚至是貌似违禁的物品，应有尽有。这里的交易由统合部监管并担保，但是考虑到只有那些持有AUR的人以及够资格的商业军团才可以进入新伊甸商城，事实上任何可能发生的风险都不复存在了。

body.en: Your hard-earned ISK is stored in your wallet. It holds the balance sheet on your recent expenditures and earnings with detailed information on every entry. If you have access to the corporation wallet, here you can also look at similar information for your corporation.
body.zh: 你的血汗钱都存在这个钱包里面了。这里你可以看到你的余额，最近的开支明细等详细信息。如果你有权限进入军团账户，你也可以查看你的军团账户的收支明细等情况。

body.en: Are you sure you want to withdraw your application?
body.zh: 你确定要撤回你的申请吗？

body.en:
If you go through this wormhole you may end up in the far reaches of space, where CONCORD will not be able to help you!


Do you wish to continue?
body.zh:
如果你穿越此虫洞，那你就将到达宇宙遥远的深处。在那里你将不会受到统合部的任何帮助！


你还要继续吗？

body.en: You are leaving … probes behind. If the wormhole collapses and you don't have enough probes on board, you may become stranded. Are you sure you want to do this?
body.zh: 你遗留了…个探针。一旦虫洞崩塌而你又没有带上足够的探针，那你就有可能被困在里面。你还要这样做吗？

body.en: By ejecting this job you will loose the time spent on the current batch. If the job requires materials then you will loose some of the materials that are required for the batch. You can check if the job requires materials by looking at the bill of materials for the job. Are you sure that you want to eject this job?
body.zh: 取消此任务会使你先前花费在这批任务上的时间全部作废。如果任务需要材料，那么你会损失这批任务所需的部分材料。你可以查看任务材料账单来确定此任务是否需要材料。你确定要取消此任务吗？

body.en: There is already a pending change to the default vulnerability time. It is currently scheduled to become … after …. If you continue, the pending change will be cleared and the new vulnerability time will become … after …. Are you sure you wish to confirm this change?
body.zh: 已有一个对默认可被攻击时段的更改正在等待生效。在…后，可被攻击时段将变更为…。如果你继续，之前的更改将被取消，在…后，新的可被攻击时段将为…。你确定要继续这项更改吗？
